item.name: Find member holdings for a known item

request.name: Find member holdings for a known item

description.content: Given a known item, find the member libraries who hold it

query.description: oclc number of the bibliographic item
isbn of the bibliographic item (bn index)
issn of the bibliographic item (in index)
Get holdings for all editions
Get holdings for specific edition across variant records
language user would prefer metadata description in
Get holdings for specific itemSubType
Restrict to holdings held by institutions in requested country
Restrict to holdings held by Institutions in requested State/Province, per ISO 3166-2.
Institution Symbol
Institution registryId
Filter holdings to specified library types
latitude
longitude
distance
distance unit
When a lat/lon is passed, the number of nearest holdings to show even if outside the search radius.
start position of the bib records to return (0 based), default 0
maximum number of records to return, maximum 50, default 10
Limiter to restrict the response to the single specified OCLC top-level facet type (x0 index). (book, image)
Limiter to restrict the response to the single specified OCLC sub facet type (x1 index). (dvd, digital)

response.name: Successful search

header.description: Content Type the client supports and is requesting (application/json currently supported)
